title: EasyMod
description: 8 new artifacts, 8 new mobs and more!
body:
🌟 EasyMod: Ancient Artifacts, New Mobs & Magical Exploration

EasyMod is a fantasy adventure mod for Minecraft that adds powerful artifacts, unique mobs, magical materials, special structures, and a new defensive block to the world.

Explore oceans, frozen lands, caves, jungles, and the night itself to uncover ancient relics and face dangerous new enemies.

[Boosty](https://boosty.to/kviziks/donate)

---

## 📖 Getting Started

When you enter the world, you receive the **Book of Artifacts** — an in-game guide that explains the relics, mobs, blocks, and ancient powers added by the mod.

---

## 🎒 Artifact Bag System

Passive artifacts only work when stored inside an **Artifact Bag**.

EasyMod includes multiple bag tiers:

- Artifact Bag — 2 slots
- Iron Artifact Bag — 3 slots
- Gold Artifact Bag — 4 slots
- Diamond Artifact Bag — 5 slots
- Netherite Artifact Bag — 8 slots

You can upgrade bags while keeping their contents.

---

## ✨ Artifacts

### Passive Artifacts
These must be placed inside an Artifact Bag:

- **Water Runners** — walk on water
- **Jumper** — grants Jump Boost II
- **Gravity Sphere** — negates fall damage
- **Magnet** — pulls nearby items
- **Invisibility Cloak** — grants true invisibility while crouching
- **Ice Ring** — slows attackers
- **Revival Totem** — saves you from death

### Active Artifacts
These are used directly from the hand:

- **Earth Core** — teleports you to the surface
- **Dimensional Teleport** — teleports you back to the Overworld
- **Time Clock** — slows nearby mobs
- **God Potion** — grants divine immortality for a limited time

---

## 👾 Mobs

EasyMod adds several custom mobs with unique mechanics and drops:

- **Wandering Drowned** — an ocean trader who sells Water Runners for Ancient Coins
- **Running Rabbit** — a very fast rabbit that drops Jumper
- **Baby Ghast** — a small dangerous nether mob that drops Gravity Sphere
- **Golden Bug** — a rare cave creature that drops Magnet
- **Firefly** — a glowing creature that drops Magic Dust
- **Shadow Walker** — a night predator that teleports behind players
- **Ice Skeleton** — a frozen skeleton with an icy aura that does not burn in sunlight
- **Ancient Golem** — a powerful mini-boss with multiple attacks and a dedicated shrine structure

---

## 🏛️ Structures

### Ancient Golem Shrine
A rare jungle structure that can be found in:

- Jungle
- Bamboo Jungle
- Sparse Jungle

Inside, you may awaken the **Ancient Golem** and challenge it in battle.

You can locate the shrine with:

/locate structure easymod:ancient_golem_shrine

# RU
EasyMod — это приключенческий мод с древними артефактами, новыми мобами, особыми структурами и магическими механиками.

В моде тебя ждут:
- система сумок артефактов
- новые пассивные и активные артефакты
- редкие мобы и ценный дроп
- Оберег Нежити для защиты базы
- Святилище Древнего Голема с мини-боссом

Подходит для выживания, исследования мира и постепенного усиления игрока.
